commit_message:
[Codegen][CPU] Lower data-tiled inner_tiled in VirtualVectorLoweringPass. (#24358)

`iree_codegen.inner_tiled` is a high-level vector op (a multi-dim
contraction whose shape is described by its kind), and lowering it to
per-intrinsic ops is "high-level vector -> lower-level dialect", which
is exactly what `LLVMCPUVirtualVectorLoweringPass` already does for
`vector.contract`, `vector.multi_reduction`, `vector.transfer_*`, and
the IREE VectorExt ops. So land the CPU `inner_tiled` lowering in
that pass rather than in a separate pass.

Three pattern populates from `IREE::Codegen` (introduced in PR
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/24351 and #24357) join the
target-independent
block of `LLVMCPUVirtualVectorLoweringPass`:

  - `IREE::Codegen::populateUnrollInnerTiledPatterns` unrolls any
    non-unit iter dim (typically a residual reduction tile) to unit.
  - `IREE::Codegen::populateDropInnerTiledUnitDimsPatterns` drops the
    (now-unit) iter domain so the lowered op has empty iter bounds,
    which is the precondition of...
  - `IREE::Codegen::populateLowerInnerTiledPatterns` replaces the
    iter-free vector-semantics `inner_tiled` with the per-intrinsic
    ops emitted by its kind's `buildUnderlyingOperations` — for
    `IREE::CPU::DataTiledMMAAttr` those are `llvm.call_intrinsic` ops.

These patterns only match `iree_codegen.inner_tiled`, so they are
orthogonal to the existing patterns in this pass; the
`DropVectorUnitDimsPass` that runs immediately before this one only
touches `vector.*` ops and similarly does not interact.

After the greedy pattern application, run
`IREE::Util::eliminateHoistableConversions` to cancel the inverse-pair
`util.hoistable_conversion` ops the inner_tiled lowering wraps around
the per-intrinsic ACC distribute/reassemble. GPU's `LowerIREEGPUOps`
pass calls this for the same reason; the introducing pattern set is
the right place to clean up after itself.

`LLVMCPUVirtualVectorLoweringPass` runs post-bufferization. That is
fine for `iree_codegen.inner_tiled`: by then the op is already in
vector semantics (lifted by `GenericVectorizationPass` via the
`InnerTiledOpVectorizationModel` `VectorizableOpInterface` external
model), and bufferization does not touch vectors.

Updates a stale forward reference in `KernelDispatch.cpp` left over
from https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/24328 — the comment described
the unit-iter-dim drop and per-
intrinsic lower patterns as firing inside a pass named
`LLVMCPULowerInnerTiledPass`, which never landed; they now fire
inside `LLVMCPUVirtualVectorLoweringPass`.

Progress towards https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/24323

---------

Signed-off-by: Benoit Jacob <jacob.benoit.1@gmail.com>

[LLVMGPU] Add TileAndFuse fallback for iree_linalg_ext.arg_compare (#24347)

This PR is a short-term fix: send arg_compare ops unsupported by the
`VectorDistribute `pipeline to `TileAndFuse`
- adds a `setArgCompareConfig` lowering-config function that routes
`iree_linalg_ext.arg_compare` ops to the `LLVMGPUTileAndFuse` pipeline
when `setReductionConfig` (the VectorDistribute path) rejects them.
- gates `iree_linalg_ext.arg_compare` vectorization in the `TileAndFuse`
pipeline only, while the resulting `iree_vector_ext.arg_compare` only
has a lowering through the nested-layout distribution patterns owned by
the VectorDistribute pipeline.
